This is now tracked by a dedicated GENERATION_PROMPT_VERSION constant in app/evaluation/prompts.py (bumped to '1.1.0' for this change), separate from JUDGE_PROMPT_VERSION (unchanged at '1.1.0') - EVALUATOR_VERSION in evaluator.py combines both as '{model}:gen{GENERATION_PROMPT_VERSION}:judge{JUDGE_PROMPT_VERSION}', so evaluator_version for every row in this batch is 'claude-sonnet-5:gen1.1.0:judge1.1.0', set live by the insert script from EVALUATOR_VERSION (not per-scenario here) - distinct from data/seed_scenarios_v2.json's 'claude-sonnet-5:1.1.0' (pre-dates the gen/judge split) and independently comparable going forward if either prompt changes again. GPT-4o now fully complies (all of its batch-2 grounding/refusal failures - GitHub Actions poor_retrieval, Big O hallucination, sorting-algorithm no_context, ibuprofen poor_retrieval, caffeine no_context, largest-desert poor_retrieval, speed-of-light hallucination - are reproduced here as passes with matching explanations). Qwen Plus improves on pure no-context refusals but still fabricates unsupported specifics when context is present-but-insufficient (poor_retrieval) or present-but-thin (hallucination), so its remaining failures are deliberately concentrated on those two root causes only (no no_context fails this round). Same field schema as seed_scenarios_v2.json; 'context' is not persisted (see scripts/seed_scenarios_v3.py).
